diagnosis: The worker completed POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED-advised full hashing of both raw parquet inputs and the nine expected/observed input identity entries matched. It then aborted in load_campaign_split on /kaggle/working/e520_source/cache/chain_folds.npz because the staged portable registry path was not handed into WNN_PORTABLE_DATA_MANIFEST. The pinned splits.py uses byte-hash verification through verify_portable_source only when that variable is set; otherwise it compares source size and mtime_ns, and the Kaggle-staged cache file failed the mtime branch. The repair is to verify the exact staged portable registry hash and set WNN_PORTABLE_DATA_MANIFEST to that path before load_campaign_split; preserve all identity and membership checks.

evidence.environment_variable_behavior: WNN_PORTABLE_DATA_MANIFEST enables verify_portable_source; absent variable falls back to size plus mtime_ns comparison
